scope.description: Two arguments: a plain value or callback, and any finite primitive/plain data value. Include callback result identity, receiver, count, and throws.

A callback and any finite list of preset plain values; invoke the returned function repeatedly with changed values and receivers. Include callback forwarding, results, throws, interleaved instances and no idle calls. Also pass callbacks in returned-call positions 0 through 3 and observe their synchronous invocation inside the original callback, exact identities, results and throws. Observe later descendants only through the exact async context of a verified application callback; they do not become a predicted library schedule. External triggers without context remain unsupported. Returned function custom properties are outside the boundary.

A callback with no custom properties. Repeated calls to the returned function, changed arguments and receivers, independent instances, callback returns and throws. Returned function custom properties are outside the boundary.
One callback, normal return only. Observe immediate return, then callbacks through a host-controlled microtask checkpoint and a bounded idle window. No arbitrary future timing claim.
